intro: I build solid APIs and web apps with TypeScript, NestJS, Angular, Django and React. Currently an intern, shipping code that runs in production.
aboutText1: I hold a Software Engineering degree from IUT Douala, and the back end is where I feel most at home: modelling data, designing clear APIs and making sure they hold up under real use.
aboutText2: At work, I build on production applications with real users and real constraints. With a team, I built E-KMER, a three-app marketplace, as my final-year project. And I’m building ArchiFlow end to end to go deeper on architecture and security. Long term, I want to become a full-stack and AI engineer.
